products.name: Royal Albert "Fragrance" 23-piece tea set
products.description:
Good evening to all!
While I am catching up with véry belated answers and feedback to everyone... I am sharing this stunning beauty with you again!
A TRUE TREASURE FOR THE ROYAL ALBERT BONE CHINA COLLECTORS!!
Royal Albert pattern:
"Fragrance"
.
Beautiful and elegant 23-piece Royal Albert "Fragrance" tea set from the renowned "Friendship Series".
The Royal Albert Fragrance pattern is a stunning, rare English bone china design from the mid-20th century, registered in 1958 (REG NO. 839038).
It features delicate pastel florals, primarily soft pinks, blues and lavenders in rose and hyacinth motifs, accented by elegant grey scrolls and 22  carat gold edging.
Set Includes:
1 x Teapot with lid
1 x Large Eared Cake Plate
1 x Milk jug
1 x Sugarbowl
6 x Teacups
6 x Saucers
6 x Cake plates
Condition:
Excellent condition overall with very faint fading in gilding on teapot's ear.
No chips, cracks, or repairs.
Made in England.
All items Factory 1st.
Courier cost for buyer's account.
**Dating Your Pieces**
The backstamp in this collection (all items are "Royal Albert Bone China England)," the registration number "Reg No 839038," and the pattern name "Fragrance", is a classic early Bone China mark used by Royal Albert from the 1940's to the 1950's.
This style was introduced around 1935-1940 when the company shifted emphasis to Bone China (replacing earlier Crown China references), but the elaborate floral garland version became standard post-World War II, aligning with the Fragrance's 1941 registration date.
It predates the 1960's-1970's script-style changes and the 1970 addition of "Ltd" after the company name.
All but one cup in this set has the later backstamp.
Production runs in the 1940's-1950's, making it an early example of the Fragrance pattern (rather than later 1960's-1980's( which runs with the simpler backstamps). Early pieces often have subtler gray scrolls, more hand-painted floral details, and higher translucency in the bone china (visible in pictutes).
**Value Adjustment**
As an early mid-century set with primarily this backstamp, it commands a premium over later productions. Combined with the globally rare large teapot (still no sightings in sales data since 2023!).

products.name: Vintage hand-embroidered tablecloth with 12 matching napkins (shown with Colleen)
products.description:
The beautiful tablecloth and 12 matching napkins shown with Colleen are also available for purchase separately.
Tablecloth: 260 × 170 cm
Includes: 12 matching napkins
Condition: Mint condition, with no damage
Courier costs are for the buyer’s account.
The white-to-ivory linen ground is decorated with elaborate counted cross-stitch embroidery in a charming palette of navy blue, red, green, pink, yellow and soft brown.
The embroidery creates a highly decorative rectangular framework incorporating geometric diamond and Greek-key motifs, scrolling foliage and richly coloured floral bouquets along the borders and at the corners.
Each of the 12 matching ivory napkins carries a coordinating cross-stitched floral and scrolling motif, finished with a delicate embroidered edge. Together, they create a particularly cohesive and elegant table setting.
The combination of geometric, folk-inspired embroidery and floral sprays gives the linen a distinctly European vintage character. The intricate counted stitching is the real feature, particularly considering the many hours of careful handwork required across a cloth of this size and twelve individually embroidered napkins.
As shown in the video, the colours in the embroidery complement Colleen beautifully, creating an especially lovely setting for the porcelain.

products.description:
Another remarkable collection has arrived and is for sale.
Produced in England, with the design carrying a Royal Albert copyright date of 1970, Cottage Garden is now a discontinued pattern, inspired by the gentle beauty of an English countryside garden and remains one of Royal Albert’s softer and more romantic floral patterns, inspired by the gentle beauty of an English countryside garden in bloom.

DINNER SERVICE FOR 12:• 12 Dinner Plates (26 cm)• 12 Entrée / Fish Plates (20.5 cm)• 12 Side Plates• 12 Soup Coups & Saucers• 12 Pudding Bowls• 2 Lidded Tureens• 1 Large Salad Bowl• 1 Salt & Pepper Set

COFFEE SERVICE FOR 12:• 12 Coffee Duos• 1 Coffee Pot with Lid
The collection retains its original serving pieces and presents beautifully throughout, with no noticeable gold loss, fading, cracks, chips, or repairs.
Rather than a formal bouquet arrangement, the pattern features delicate sprays of pink roses, trailing greenery, and scattered cottage florals in a style that feels whimsical, natural, and almost watercolor-like in appearance.
Collectors are often drawn to Cottage Garden for precisely this reason — it feels less formal dining room and more afternoon tea in an English garden.

Elegant Tea Service

There is something timeless about fine English bone china, it has such quiet elegance.

About the Makers
Royal Grafton
Produced by A.B. Jones & Sons in Staffordshire, England, Royal Grafton was most active during the mid-20th century (circa 1930s–1970s), known for its refined yet accessible fine bone china.
Tuscan China
Established in 1878 in Staffordshire, Tuscan became especially popular during the 1940s–1960s, producing elegant teaware of exceptional quality before later becoming associated with Wedgwood.
Pattern
Pattern name not officially documented —
however, the soft blush tone with delicate detailing reflects classic mid-century English styling (circa 1950s–1960s).
Material
Fine Bone China vs China
Fine bone china contains bone ash, making it:
• Lighter
• Stronger
• Slightly translucent
• More refined
What Makes This Set Special
• Beautifully curated combination of two English makers
• Soft, feminine colour palette
• Includes both tea and coffee pots
• Perfect for entertaining or display
Condition
Mint condition
• No chips

• No staining
• Gilding remains bright and elegant
Close-up images and video included to reflect true condition and detail.

A graceful example of how English craftsmanship remains timeless — even when brought together across makers.

fine English bone china and timeless elegance.

products.description:
Complete Tea & Coffee Collection for 12
Made in England
There is something especially beautiful about seeing an older Royal Albert collection preserved completely — not only admired for its elegance, but appreciated for the history it carries with it.
This particular Old Country Roses tea and coffee collection for 12 has already found its home, but it felt far too special not to share.
Made in England and dating to the earlier period before the 1962 registered mark, it carries that unmistakable old-world charm that collectors so often search for — delicate workmanship, rich colour, graceful shapes and the warmth that only vintage English bone china seems to hold.
Some pieces are simply collected. Others are chosen.
And perhaps that is why we continue to treasure Royal Albert so deeply — not merely for the porcelain itself, but for the atmosphere it creates, the memories it holds, and the quiet elegance it brings into a home.
For those who appreciate the quieter side of elegance.
With appreciation,
Adri
Adri's Royal Albert Boutique and Collectables South Africa

About Mappin & Webb
Mappin & Webb is a renowned British silversmith and luxury goods maker that traces its roots back to 1797, becoming one of the most respected makers of silver and silver-plated flatware in the UK.
Important Factors That Affect Value
Here’s what really moves the price up or down:
1. Material
Silver-Plated: These sets are the most common. They’re collectible but not as valuable as sterling.
Sterling Silver (925): Dramatically more valuable — sterling canteens can reach tens of thousands of ZAR (especially antique King’s pattern).
AC Silver
2. Completeness
A full 8-place setting with all serving pieces and the original fitted canteen box is worth significantly more than a partial set.
3. Condition
Rust, wear on plating, scratches, dents, or a missing box/key lowers price. A well-preserved boxed set fetches a premium.
4. Local Demand
In South Africa, silverware/cutlery markets are somewhat niche; good plating sets with box often find buyers around R20 000–R35 000 if clean and nice.

products.name: Hammersley “Victorian Violets”: 50-piece grand tea and coffee service for eight
products.description:
This Victorian beauty is still available!
Hammersley “Victorian Violets”
50-Piece Grand Tea & Coffee Service for 8
Hand-painted Longton bone china • 1947–1955 •
PRICE: R24 860.00 for complete collection
Available in South Africa
A SET COLLECTORS RECOGNISE INSTANTLY
Some patterns whisper.
Others announce themselves the moment they enter a room.
“Victorian Violets” is one of them.
Picture a quiet Staffordshire morning…
At the Hammersley works on Sutherland Road, a paintress dips her squirrel-hair brush into violet wash and gently brings a cluster of flowers to life on a blank saucer.
Seventy-five years later, those same soft, matte violets—each one slightly different—are ready for your table.
WHAT IS INCLUDED
1 footed teapot + rose-knob lid (6-cup)
1 footed coffee pot + rose-knob lid (6-cup)
2 scalloped milk jugs (one low, one tall)
2 open sugar bowls with gilded interiors
8 tea trios (cup, saucer, 20 cm plate)
8 coffee duos (tall can cup + saucer)
2 broad 25 cm cake plates
Total: 50 pieces
WHY THIS SET STANDS OUT
Every handle curls like a vine.
Every spout and rim is finished with hand-applied gold that still catches the light beautifully.
Hold a piece up to the window and you’ll see that signature glow—fine, translucent bone china at its best.
AUTHENTICITY & PERIOD
Hand-painted | 1947–1955
Produced during Hammersley’s golden post-war years, this set carries the characteristic green backstamps of the period—an important detail for collectors.
A LITTLE HISTORY
Founded in 1862 in the heart of the Potteries, Hammersley remained a family business for over a century.
“Victorian Violets” became one of their most loved patterns—advertised in London as early as 1913.
Each violet is free-hand painted, meaning no two pieces are ever exactly the same.
A CHARMING FACTORY DETAIL
One coffee saucer is approximately 5 mm wider than the others—
a small but lovely reminder of true hand production.
It fits perfectly and adds to the authenticity of the set.
CONDITION
Flawless.
No chips, cracks, or crazing.
Gold bright. Violets vivid.
Beautifully preserved and ready to use or display.
FROM MY COLLECTION TO YOUR HOME
Carefully sourced for collectors who appreciate quality, history, and complete sets.
Kind regards,
Adri Knoetze

reviews.text: Adrie is very friendly and trustworthy. I can realy recommend her. I am very happy with my beautiful trio’s that I baught from her. Delivery was very fast. I wil definitely buy from her again.

reviews.name: Tiaan Ras
reviews.text: It was pure joy dealing with Adri. She is more than just knowledgeable (and she is), she is also passionate. And that elevated our interaction from a mere transaction to a very personal exchange. Thanks Adri!

reviews.name: Martina Venter
reviews.text: I bought the most beautiful Enchantment tea set for two from Adri and am extremely satisfied with my purchase!  Adri was very helpful, professional, and efficient and I received my set within two days of order via courier (all safe and sound)!

reviews.name: Daniel Booysen
reviews.text: What a beautiful collection of genuine Royal Albert China ware. Adri the host treated us with tea and coffee from one of her prestine collection sets. Her knowledge about the Royal Albert sets and passion is clearly evident. A wonderful experience we had indeed.

reviews.name: Marelize Möller
reviews.text: What a phenomenal woman!! Excellent service - whispered in her ear and gave my husband her number and together they made my dreams come true! Adri has a passion for Royal Albert and it can be seen! Thank you for my beautiful Tea pot. My set is complete, but can't wait for my next purchase!

reviews.name: Japie Snyman
reviews.text: HONEST, RELIABLE KEEP HER PROMISES! SPEEDY DELIVERY. HER PACKAGING CAN'T BE IMPROVED. DELIVERED AN EXPENSIVE RA 22PCE  SAFE AND SOUND FROM POTGIETERSRUS TO LICHTENBURG! VERY GREAT EXPERIENCE BUYING FROM HER!

reviews.name: Beverley Barnard
reviews.text: Super friendly, beautiful set up, exquisite sets, top quality items, a touch of royalty in every piece. Adri is a beautiful soul

reviews.name: Nompie En Nico Pieterse
reviews.text: Ek het Adri via WhatsApp gekontak op soek na 2 Vald'or koppies alhoewel ek besef het sy verkoop net stelle,  sy was ernstig siek op daardie stadium maar tenspyte van haar ongesteldheid het sy vriendelik gehelp ....sy het my belowe sy gaan haar beste probeer om my te help....ek kan Adri met die hoogste agting aanbeveel sy verdien 10 sterre nie net 5 nie , betroubaar , beste diens, vriendelik en liefdevol , geduldig en professioneel....sy het haar beloftes aan my nagekom en my koppies gekry . Ek beveel Adri's Royal Albert Collectables South Africa aan vir die beste diens ! Adri het ver agteroor gebuig om my te help .... Pragtige mens !

reviews.name: Adrienne Jansen van Rensburg
reviews.text: Adri is n baie betroubare verkoper. Die voorraad is altyd van hoogstaande kwaliteit. Haar moeite om verpakking deeglik en sekuur te doen, is "impressive". Dankie Adri, dis met gemoedsrus wat jou posts en ads altyd waarde vir geld inhou. Dis n plesier om by jou te koop.

reviews.name: Heino Robberts
reviews.text:
Ek het die heel mooiste heirloom royal albert by adri gekoop die mooiste stel en baie baie duur en duursaam.
Dit was verpak met baie liefde dat dit nooit sal kan breek nie en dit was binne 2 dae by my.
die royal albert kwaliteit is soos uit n fabriek almal kan maar vir adri ondersteun want jy kry waarvoor jy betaal het.
